content.text:
Added a checkbox to mark each todo done, and All / Active / Completed filter buttons (All is the default). The ordering rule is in `visibleTodos` in `todo-logic.js`, and `node check/todo-logic.check.cjs` passes. I haven't opened the page in a browser.

Chose: completed todos go below active ones, in the order they were added, and a comment in `todo-logic.js` records this rule. Each todo's done state is saved; the chosen filter is not, so a reload goes back to All.
Why: the ordering rule holds for the rest of the project, so it sits in one pure function with a check.
Rejected: saving the filter, since All is the default; `require` in the check, because the parent `package.json` sets `"type": "module"`, so it loads the file with `vm`.
